# The runtime chronicle: a fixed number of remembered things per title, newest first,
# and the same for the world on title:h_china. Written by Emit/ChronicleRuntimeWriter.cs.
#
# Every push shifts the slots down one and writes slot 0. Nothing here is clever; the
# length comes from variable names not being buildable at runtime, so each slot is
# spelled out. The window reads the slots back through customizable_localization
# (gen_chr_line_N), never directly.
#
# ACTOR and OTHER are scope expressions valid where the effect is CALLED. The fan-out
# effects save them as temporary scopes first, because `holder` means something
# different on every rung of the liege chain.

# Title scope. 12 slots, prefix `chr_`. TMPL, ACTOR, OTHER.

# Any scope. Captures the two parties before changing scope to the world title, so a
# caller's `holder` or `root` still means what it meant at the call site.
gen_chr_push_world_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = $ACTOR$ }
		$ACTOR$ = { save_temporary_scope_as = gen_chr_actor }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = $OTHER$ }
		$OTHER$ = { save_temporary_scope_as = gen_chr_other }
	}
	title:h_china ?= {
		gen_chr_push_world_inner_effect = { TMPL = $TMPL$ ACTOR = scope:gen_chr_actor OTHER = scope:gen_chr_other }
	}
}

gen_chr_push_world_plain_effect = {
	title:h_china ?= {
		gen_chr_push_world_plain_inner_effect = { TMPL = $TMPL$ }
	}
}

# Title scope, reading scope:gen_chr_actor and scope:gen_chr_other, which the two
# effects below it save. This title, then every de jure liege short of the hegemony —
# that title is the world store, and the world gets its own push when WORLD = yes.
gen_chr_push_chain_inner_effect = {
	gen_chr_push_effect = { TMPL = $TMPL$ ACTOR = scope:gen_chr_actor OTHER = scope:gen_chr_other }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = de_jure_liege  de_jure_liege = { NOT = { tier = tier_hegemony } } }
		de_jure_liege = {
			gen_chr_push_effect = { TMPL = $TMPL$ ACTOR = scope:gen_chr_actor OTHER = scope:gen_chr_other }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = de_jure_liege  de_jure_liege = { NOT = { tier = tier_hegemony } } }
				de_jure_liege = {
					gen_chr_push_effect = { TMPL = $TMPL$ ACTOR = scope:gen_chr_actor OTHER = scope:gen_chr_other }
					if = {
						limit = { exists = de_jure_liege  de_jure_liege = { NOT = { tier = tier_hegemony } } }
						de_jure_liege = {
							gen_chr_push_effect = { TMPL = $TMPL$ ACTOR = scope:gen_chr_actor OTHER = scope:gen_chr_other }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { always = $WORLD$ }
		title:h_china ?= {
			gen_chr_push_world_inner_effect = { TMPL = $TMPL$ ACTOR = scope:gen_chr_actor OTHER = scope:gen_chr_other }
		}
	}
}

# Title scope. TMPL, ACTOR, OTHER, WORLD. The two parties are saved before the climb
# because `holder` means somebody else on every rung.
gen_chr_push_chain_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = $ACTOR$ }
		$ACTOR$ = { save_temporary_scope_as = gen_chr_actor }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = $OTHER$ }
		$OTHER$ = { save_temporary_scope_as = gen_chr_other }
	}
	gen_chr_push_chain_inner_effect = { TMPL = $TMPL$ WORLD = $WORLD$ }
}

# County scope. TMPL, ACTOR, WORLD; the county is the entry's other party on every
# rung, which is what lets a kingdom's panel say WHICH county fell.
gen_chr_push_up_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = gen_chr_other
	if = {
		limit = { exists = $ACTOR$ }
		$ACTOR$ = { save_temporary_scope_as = gen_chr_actor }
	}
	gen_chr_push_chain_inner_effect = { TMPL = $TMPL$ WORLD = $WORLD$ }
}

# Root = the new holder; scope:title and scope:transfer_type, as on_title_gain gives them.
gen_chr_on_title_gain_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:title = {
				tier >= tier_kingdom
				is_landless_type_title = no
			}
			exists = scope:transfer_type
			NOT = { has_trait = wilderness }
		}
		scope:title = {
			# World-worthy: any empire, or a kingdom by anything but plain inheritance.
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						tier >= tier_empire
						NOT = { scope:transfer_type = flag:inheritance }
					}
				}
				gen_chr_title_gain_arms_effect = { WORLD = yes }
			}
			else = {
				gen_chr_title_gain_arms_effect = { WORLD = no }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Title scope, from the effect above. One line per way a crown can move.
gen_chr_title_gain_arms_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:transfer_type = flag:inheritance }
		gen_chr_push_chain_effect = { TMPL = gen_chr_crown_inherited ACTOR = root OTHER = scope:title WORLD = $WORLD$ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:transfer_type = flag:usurped }
		gen_chr_push_chain_effect = { TMPL = gen_chr_crown_usurped ACTOR = root OTHER = scope:title WORLD = $WORLD$ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:transfer_type = flag:conquest
				scope:transfer_type = flag:conquest_holy_war
				scope:transfer_type = flag:conquest_claim
				scope:transfer_type = flag:conquest_populist
			}
		}
		gen_chr_push_chain_effect = { TMPL = gen_chr_crown_conquered ACTOR = root OTHER = scope:title WORLD = $WORLD$ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:transfer_type = flag:created }
		gen_chr_push_chain_effect = { TMPL = gen_chr_crown_created ACTOR = root OTHER = scope:title WORLD = $WORLD$ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:transfer_type = flag:election }
		gen_chr_push_chain_effect = { TMPL = gen_chr_crown_elected ACTOR = root OTHER = scope:title WORLD = $WORLD$ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:transfer_type = flag:granted
				scope:transfer_type = flag:abdication
				scope:transfer_type = flag:faction_demand
				scope:transfer_type = flag:independency
				scope:transfer_type = flag:returned
				scope:transfer_type = flag:revoked
				scope:transfer_type = flag:swear_fealty
				scope:transfer_type = flag:stepped_down
			}
		}
		gen_chr_push_chain_effect = { TMPL = gen_chr_crown_passed ACTOR = root OTHER = scope:title WORLD = $WORLD$ }
	}
	# Leases and lease revocations say nothing: a title on loan has not changed hands.
}

# Root = the holder before destruction; scope:landed_title. The title itself keeps its
# variables but nobody will open it again, so the line goes to whatever stood above it.
gen_chr_on_title_destroyed_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:landed_title = {
				tier >= tier_kingdom
				is_landless_type_title = no
			}
			NOT = { has_trait = wilderness }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:landed_title.de_jure_liege }
			scope:landed_title.de_jure_liege = {
				gen_chr_push_chain_effect = { TMPL = gen_chr_crown_destroyed ACTOR = root OTHER = scope:landed_title WORLD = yes }
			}
		}
		else = {
			gen_chr_push_world_effect = { TMPL = gen_chr_crown_destroyed ACTOR = root OTHER = scope:landed_title }
		}
	}
}

# scope:attacker, scope:defender and the target_titles list, exactly as a casus belli's
# own on_victory sees them (on_war_won_attacker / _defender).
#
# ---- Why this says so much less than it did ----
#
# The first version wrote one line per target title, sent every kingdom-tier line to
# the world, and narrated attacker victories that on_title_gain was narrating anyway as
# "took X by force of arms" — with the actual new holder named, which this cannot do.
# The world's book filled with wars inside a generation (seen on screen, 2026-09-09).
#
# So: one line per war, for its foremost prize. A crown TAKEN is on_title_gain's line
# and is not repeated here. A crown HELD is the realm's own news, never the world's.
# A duchy won stays in the duchy's book and its kingdom's; a duchy held, in the duchy's.
# Wars that move no title — subjugations, independence — go unrecorded at kingdom
# tier; that is the price of not writing everything twice.

# The attacker won. Duchy prizes only; a kingdom taken is on_title_gain's to tell.
gen_chr_on_war_won_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { any_in_list = { list = target_titles  tier >= tier_kingdom  is_landless_type_title = no } }
			any_in_list = { list = target_titles  tier = tier_duchy  is_landless_type_title = no }
		}
		random_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			limit = { tier = tier_duchy  is_landless_type_title = no }
			save_temporary_scope_as = gen_chr_war_title
			gen_chr_push_effect = { TMPL = gen_chr_war_won ACTOR = scope:attacker OTHER = scope:gen_chr_war_title }
			de_jure_liege ?= {
				gen_chr_push_effect = { TMPL = gen_chr_war_won ACTOR = scope:attacker OTHER = scope:gen_chr_war_title }
			}
		}
	}
}

# The defender held. The foremost prize's own book — and its liege's when it is a crown.
gen_chr_on_war_held_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { any_in_list = { list = target_titles  tier >= tier_kingdom  is_landless_type_title = no } }
		random_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			limit = { tier >= tier_kingdom  is_landless_type_title = no }
			save_temporary_scope_as = gen_chr_war_title
			gen_chr_push_chain_effect = { TMPL = gen_chr_war_held ACTOR = scope:defender OTHER = scope:gen_chr_war_title WORLD = no }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_in_list = { list = target_titles  tier = tier_duchy  is_landless_type_title = no } }
		random_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			limit = { tier = tier_duchy  is_landless_type_title = no }
			save_temporary_scope_as = gen_chr_war_title
			gen_chr_push_effect = { TMPL = gen_chr_war_held ACTOR = scope:defender OTHER = scope:gen_chr_war_title }
		}
	}
}

# Root = the new faith; scope:founder (on_faith_created). In 1.19 root was the founder;
# 1.20 made it the faith. Into the founder's realm books and the world; a landless
# founder is world news only. The game also creates faiths with no acting character
# (vanilla enters scope:founder with ?=), and with no actor there is no line to write.
gen_chr_on_faith_created_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:founder.capital_county }
		scope:founder.capital_county = {
			gen_chr_push_chain_effect = { TMPL = gen_chr_faith_founded ACTOR = scope:founder OTHER = root WORLD = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:founder }
		gen_chr_push_world_effect = { TMPL = gen_chr_faith_founded ACTOR = scope:founder OTHER = root }
	}
}

# Root = the new culture; scope:founder (on_culture_created).
gen_chr_on_culture_created_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:founder.capital_county }
		scope:founder.capital_county = {
			gen_chr_push_chain_effect = { TMPL = gen_chr_culture_founded ACTOR = scope:founder OTHER = root WORLD = yes }
		}
	}
	else = {
		gen_chr_push_world_effect = { TMPL = gen_chr_culture_founded ACTOR = scope:founder OTHER = root }
	}
}

# Global, from yearly_global_pulse. Coronations have no on_action of their own; what a
# coronation leaves behind is the crowned law on the ruler's realm, and this notices it
# once per reign. The flag is per character and the law is stripped at succession, so
# each new ruler's own coronation is a fresh line. Up to a year late, which is fine for
# a chronicle. World news at empire tier only.
gen_chr_coronation_sweep_effect = {
	every_ruler = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_character_flag = gen_chr_crowned }
			OR = {
				has_realm_law = crowned_king
				has_realm_law = crowned_emperor
			}
			exists = primary_title
			primary_title = { is_landless_type_title = no }
			NOT = { has_trait = wilderness }
		}
		add_character_flag = gen_chr_crowned
		save_temporary_scope_as = gen_chr_crowned_ruler
		primary_title = {
			save_temporary_scope_as = gen_chr_crowned_title
			if = {
				limit = { tier >= tier_empire }
				gen_chr_push_chain_effect = { TMPL = gen_chr_crowned ACTOR = scope:gen_chr_crowned_ruler OTHER = scope:gen_chr_crowned_title WORLD = yes }
			}
			else = {
				gen_chr_push_chain_effect = { TMPL = gen_chr_crowned ACTOR = scope:gen_chr_crowned_ruler OTHER = scope:gen_chr_crowned_title WORLD = no }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Global. Narrates a Dynastic Cycle phase change once, into the world's book.
gen_chr_cycle_check_effect = {
	situation:dynastic_cycle ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = gen_chr_phase } }
			if = { limit = { situation_current_phase = situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_stability } set_variable = { name = gen_chr_phase value = flag:situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_stability } }
			else_if = { limit = { situation_current_phase = situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_stability_expansion } set_variable = { name = gen_chr_phase value = flag:situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_stability_expansion } }
			else_if = { limit = { situation_current_phase = situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_stability_advancement } set_variable = { name = gen_chr_phase value = flag:situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_stability_advancement } }
			else_if = { limit = { situation_current_phase = situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_instability } set_variable = { name = gen_chr_phase value = flag:situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_instability } }
			else_if = { limit = { situation_current_phase = situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_instability_conquest } set_variable = { name = gen_chr_phase value = flag:situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_instability_conquest } }
			else_if = { limit = { situation_current_phase = situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_chaos } set_variable = { name = gen_chr_phase value = flag:situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_chaos } }
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { situation_current_phase = situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_stability  NOT = { var:gen_chr_phase = flag:situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_stability } }
				set_variable = { name = gen_chr_phase value = flag:situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_stability }
				gen_chr_push_world_effect = { TMPL = gen_chr_cycle_stability ACTOR = title:h_china.holder OTHER = title:h_china }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { situation_current_phase = situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_stability_expansion  NOT = { var:gen_chr_phase = flag:situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_stability_expansion } }
				set_variable = { name = gen_chr_phase value = flag:situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_stability_expansion }
				gen_chr_push_world_effect = { TMPL = gen_chr_cycle_expansion ACTOR = title:h_china.holder OTHER = title:h_china }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { situation_current_phase = situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_stability_advancement  NOT = { var:gen_chr_phase = flag:situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_stability_advancement } }
				set_variable = { name = gen_chr_phase value = flag:situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_stability_advancement }
				gen_chr_push_world_effect = { TMPL = gen_chr_cycle_advancement ACTOR = title:h_china.holder OTHER = title:h_china }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { situation_current_phase = situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_instability  NOT = { var:gen_chr_phase = flag:situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_instability } }
				set_variable = { name = gen_chr_phase value = flag:situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_instability }
				gen_chr_push_world_effect = { TMPL = gen_chr_cycle_tension ACTOR = title:h_china.holder OTHER = title:h_china }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { situation_current_phase = situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_instability_conquest  NOT = { var:gen_chr_phase = flag:situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_instability_conquest } }
				set_variable = { name = gen_chr_phase value = flag:situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_instability_conquest }
				gen_chr_push_world_effect = { TMPL = gen_chr_cycle_conquest ACTOR = title:h_china.holder OTHER = title:h_china }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { situation_current_phase = situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_chaos  NOT = { var:gen_chr_phase = flag:situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_chaos } }
				set_variable = { name = gen_chr_phase value = flag:situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_chaos }
				gen_chr_push_world_effect = { TMPL = gen_chr_cycle_division ACTOR = title:h_china.holder OTHER = title:h_china }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Sub-region scope, PHASE = the era just entered. Narrates a frontier's era turning.
# Strictly after the bookmark year: the start phase's on_start fires at game start.
gen_chr_wilds_effect = {
}
